```{python}
#| echo: false
import json
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open(summary_json_path, "r") as f:
    s = json.load(f)

bi = s["base_indicators"]
ds = s["detailed_summary"]
dr = s["date_range"]
verdict = bi["verdict"]
verdict_color = {"PASS": "#198754", "WARN": "#fd7e14", "FAIL": "#dc3545"}.get(verdict, "#6c757d")

report_dir = Path(summary_json_path).parent

account_name = s.get("account_name")
account_display = (
    f"{account_name} <span style='color:#888;font-size:0.9em;'>({s['account_id']})</span>"
    if account_name else s["account_id"]
)

display(HTML(f"""
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin-bottom:24px;">
  <div style="font-size:1.1rem; color:#555;">
    <strong>Account:</strong> {account_display}<br>
    <strong>Period:</strong> {dr['start']} &ndash; {dr['end']}<br>
    <strong>Run:</strong> {s['run_timestamp']}
  </div>
  <div style="margin-left:auto; background:{verdict_color}; color:white;
              padding:10px 24px; border-radius:6px; font-size:1.4rem; font-weight:bold;">
    {verdict}
  </div>
</div>
"""))
```

## Base Indicators

```{python}
#| echo: false
rows = [
    ("Trip Coverage", f"{bi['trip_coverage_pct']}%"),
    ("Total Trips in Collection", bi['total_trips_in_collection']),
    ("Missing from trip_agg", bi['missing_trip_count']),
    ("Complete Trips", bi['complete_trips']),
    ("Unbroken Unmatched", bi['unbroken_unmatched_count']),
    ("Broken Unmatched", bi['broken_unmatched_count']),
]

table_rows = "".join(
    f"<tr><td style='padding:6px 12px;color:#555;'>{k}</td>"
    f"<td style='padding:6px 12px;font-weight:600;'>{v}</td></tr>"
    for k, v in rows
)

display(HTML(f"""
<table style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; max-width:480px;">
  <tbody>{table_rows}</tbody>
</table>
"""))
```

## Alert Mismatches

```{python}
#| echo: false
mismatched = ds.get("mismatched_alerts", [])
passed = ds.get("passed_alerts", [])
total_joined = ds.get("total_joined_trips_for_alert_comparison", 0)

if mismatched:
    header = "<tr><th style='text-align:left;padding:6px 12px;border-bottom:2px solid #dee2e6;'>Alert</th><th style='padding:6px 12px;border-bottom:2px solid #dee2e6;'>Mismatches</th><th style='padding:6px 12px;border-bottom:2px solid #dee2e6;'>Mismatch %</th></tr>"
    rows_html = "".join(
        f"<tr><td style='padding:6px 12px;'>{r['alert_name']}</td>"
        f"<td style='padding:6px 12px;text-align:center;'>{r['mismatch_count']}</td>"
        f"<td style='padding:6px 12px;text-align:center;'>{r['mismatch_pct']}%</td></tr>"
        for r in mismatched
    )
    display(HTML(f"""
    <p style="color:#555;font-size:0.9rem;">Compared across {total_joined} trips</p>
    <table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;max-width:560px;">
      <thead>{header}</thead>
      <tbody>{rows_html}</tbody>
    </table>
    """))
else:
    display(HTML("<p style='color:#198754;'>✓ No alert mismatches found.</p>"))

if passed:
    passed_str = ", ".join(passed)
    display(HTML(f"""
    <details style="margin-top:16px;">
      <summary style="cursor:pointer;color:#555;">Passed alerts ({len(passed)})</summary>
      <p style="margin-top:8px;color:#555;font-size:0.9rem;">{passed_str}</p>
    </details>
    """))
```

## Files

```{python}
#| echo: false
links = []

log_path = report_dir / "run.log"
if log_path.exists():
    links.append(f'<a href="run.log">📋 Execution Log</a>')

csvs = sorted(report_dir.glob("*.csv"))
if csvs:
    csv_links = " &nbsp;|&nbsp; ".join(
        f'<a href="{c.name}">{c.stem}</a>' for c in csvs
    )
    links.append(f"📂 CSVs: {csv_links}")

if links:
    display(HTML("<br>".join(links)))
```
